newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock indices close at historic highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock indices close at historic highs.

text.p: Madrid share indices closed at new highs on Tuesday, buoyed by strength in selected firms and after tracking bonds and other key stock markets higher, traders said.
The general index closed up 2.82 points, 0.73 percent, at 387.06. The Ibex-35 climbed 38.18 points, 0.86 percent, to close at 4,459.54.
"The market appeared very firm although today's rise is a bit overdone and is due to increases in isolated companies, and at the close you could see it was getting tired," said one trader.

Repsol held onto early gains despite posting marginally worse than expected results just before the close. The company said net profit for the first nine months of 1996 fell 5.6 percent to 86.98 billion pesetas. Shares closed 60 pesetas up at 4,295.
Telefonica closed 10 pesetas up at 2,690 amid expectations that nine month profits, due this week, would show a 21.7 percent rise.

Shares in energy group Gas Natural rose over seven percent to 24,900 pesetas after the company posted a 33 percent rise in net consolidated profit for the first nine months of 1996 to 33.545 billion pesetas.
Although traders received the figures warmly they attributed the majority of the rise to heavy buying by Merrill Lynch and could not rule out a correction in early trade on Wednesday.
